verdict.rationale: Amplitude offers some autonomous-style mechanisms — feature flag rollout that can auto-adjust ('turn it off the moment something looks wrong'), and an embeddable in-product agent that 'answers questions, guides flows, and complete tasks for users' — which resemble background automations, but there is no documentation of a general automation/workflow-builder for AI-native users to configure arbitrary autonomous background tasks. missing for 10: a dedicated automation/workflow engine, scheduling or trigger-based agent tasks beyond flag rollout and embedded chat, and any evidence of user-configured autonomous background jobs.
